first_page_lines: CARE Checklist of information to include when writing a case report
Title                  1    The diagnosis or intervention of primary focus followed by the words “case report” ..................................................... Yes, Line-2
Key Words              2    2 to 5 key words that identify diagnoses or interventions in this case report, including "case report" ........... Yes, 33-34
Abstract              3a    Introduction: What is unique about this case and what does it add to the scientific literature? ................................. Yes, 14-17
3d    Conclusion—What is the main “take-away” lesson(s) from this case?................................................................... Yes, 27-31
Introduction           4    One or two paragraphs summarizing why this case is unique (may include references) ........................... Yes, 54-60
5c    Medical, family, and psycho-social history including relevant genetic information....................................... Yes,66-67
Clinical Findings      6    Describe significant physical examination (PE) and important clinical findings ........................................... Yes,64-66
Timeline               7    Historical and current information from this episode of care organized as a timeline.................................... NA
Diagnostic            8a    Diagnostic testing (such as PE, laboratory testing, imaging, surveys)........................................................ Yes,68-83
Assessment
8b    Diagnostic challenges (such as access to testing, financial, or cultural) ...................................................... NA
Therapeutic           9a    Types of therapeutic intervention (such as pharmacologic, surgical, preventive, self-care)...................................... Yes,86-87
Intervention
9b    Administration of therapeutic intervention (such as dosage, strength, duration) ...................................................... Yes,94-96
Outcomes
10c   Intervention adherence and tolerability (How was this assessed?) ........................................................................ Yes,88
